text.arabic_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًۭا

words.gloss_range: comparison particle governing the following demonstrative and opening a retrospective discourse frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fused comparison-demonstrative phrase, pointing back to the prior scene

words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) does not open a fresh narrative item by itself. As the comparison side of {{ar:كَذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:kadhālika}}), it binds the verse back to the preceding sunrise-side scene (18:90), making the new divine assertion read as a retrospective hinge: the prior scene is the comparison base, and the knowledge clause explains how that scene was already contained.

topics.headline: retrospective comparison hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first turns backward to the completed scene before it gives the divine knowledge frame.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar identifies {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) as comparison, and attachment evidence ties {{ar:كَذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:kadhālika}}) to the preceding episode, so the CRITICAL comparison, fused form, and boundary rows are locally supported.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative recovering a prior discourse unit inside the comparison phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fused comparison-demonstrative phrase, pointing back to the prior scene

words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) supplies the content-bearing pointer in {{ar:كَذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:kadhālika}}). Its definiteness assumes that the reader can recover the referent from 18:90, while its distal quality holds that scene at discourse distance as a completed object of comment. The result is not another travel event but a seal that lets the verse pivot into divine assessment.

topics.headline: definite distal scene seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a single demonstrative gathers the prior scene into a completed unit before commentary begins.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) as a demonstrative governed by {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}), with referent supplied by the prior episode.

topics.headline: boundary-marker recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase has boundary-marking force here, while the local syntax keeps it tied to this immediate episode.
topics.reason: The recurrence claim is useful as discourse pressure, but without a concrete local cross-reference list it should not control the parse beyond the demonstrative's boundary position.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector in a {{ar:وَقَدْ}} ({{tr:wa-qad}}) sequence, with circumstantial background pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: connector plus certainty particle opening a verified background clause

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the opening seal and the verified knowledge clause as distinct beats. In {{ar:وَقَدْ}} ({{tr:wa-qad}}), the connector does not simply continue the travel sequence; it opens a divine aside and can also make that aside the background condition under which the scene unfolded.

topics.headline: backgrounded divine aside
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector changes discourse layer instead of adding another travel action.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) here as resumptive, and the clause evidence places {{ar:وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا}} ({{tr:wa-qad aḥaṭnā}}) as the finite predicate of the resumed divine statement.

words.gloss_range: certainty particle with a perfect verb, marking verified completed action with anterior/background force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: perfect verb whose completed action is verified by {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}})

words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) verifies the whole knowledge assertion, not just the verb stem. With the perfect {{ar:أَحَطْنَا}} ({{tr:aḥaṭnā}}), it makes divine encompassing an already completed and assured fact, so the audience receives the clause as backgrounded epistemic framing rather than a new inference from the journey scene.

topics.headline: verified prior completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge is presented as already complete before the narrated scene is assessed.
topics.reason: The local verb is perfect, so {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) carries taḥqīq and completed-background force rather than possibility.

words.gloss_range: completed divine encompassing directed through a bāʾ-marked domain and specified as knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes surrounding, guarding, wall/enclosure imagery, complete grasp, maneuvering, ruin/overtaking, ornament, and completion of deficiency; local Form IV plus {{ar:خُبْرًا}} ({{tr:khubran}}) selects comprehensive epistemic encompassing while preserving enclosure imagery

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first-person plural subject suffix carried inside the verb
bāʾ-governed relative domain, whatever was with him
accusative knowledge specification of the encompassing verb

words.prose: {{ar:أَحَطْنَا}} ({{tr:aḥaṭnā}}) is the clause pivot. Its Form IV perfect and fused {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}) subject present a completed divine act, while the following {{ar:بِمَا لَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:bimā ladayhi}}) gives the domain and {{ar:خُبْرًا}} ({{tr:khubran}}) gives the knowledge-mode. The root's surrounding and wall-field pressure remains visible, but the final accusative narrows the local action from physical encirclement to epistemic enclosure: whatever was with Dhū al-Qarnayn is already held within completed divine knowledge. This also answers same-surah failure or passivity around encompassing at 18:42 and 18:68, and it participates in broader divine-knowledge formulas (2:255; 4:108; 65:12) without becoming generic.

topics.headline: domain and mode frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause is architected as act, domain, and knowledge-mode rather than a simple object statement.
topics.reason: Attachment and valency evidence confirm that the verb governs a {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) complement and receives {{ar:خُبْرًا}} ({{tr:khubran}}) as accusative specification.

topics.headline: completed divine active agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that encompassment is not lacking, passive, attempted, or ongoing here; it is completed by the divine speaker.
topics.reason: The local form is active perfect Form IV with first-person plural agreement, and same-surah contrasts at 18:42 and 18:68 sharpen the active divine completion without overriding the local parse.

topics.headline: spatial enclosure converted into knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the concrete perimeter image inside the verb, while the local grammar makes that perimeter an image of comprehensive knowing.
topics.reason: V4 supports surrounding, guarding, and wall-field branches for {{ar:ح و ط}} ({{tr:ḥ-w-ṭ}}), but {{ar:خُبْرًا}} ({{tr:khubran}}) narrows local activation to epistemic encompassing rather than architecture, self-precaution, or simple guarding.

topics.headline: formulaic divine knowledge localized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a wider Quranic divine-knowledge construction, but sees it anchored to Dhū al-Qarnayn's immediate domain here.
topics.reason: The {{ar:أَحَاطَ}} ({{tr:aḥāṭa}}) plus {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) pattern is supported as a divine-knowledge frame (2:255; 4:108; 65:12), while the local object remains {{ar:مَا لَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:mā ladayhi}}).

topics.headline: pivot from journey to aside
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb replaces travel narration with the main assertion of a divine aside.
topics.reason: The clause begins after the deictic seal and contains the finite predicate of the resumed statement, so this verb is the structural pivot.

topics.headline: phonetic density
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The row adds sound-texture only; the semantic and grammatical enclosure topics already carry the reader-facing payoff.
topics.reason: No guardrail contradicts the phonetic observation, but it is decorative at this processing layer and would not materially guide lexical review or translation.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the open relative domain after the encompassing verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: encompassing verb that selects the bāʾ-marked domain
open relative domain completed by the locative possessor phrase
accusative knowledge specification kept distinct from the governed domain

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the small hinge that lets {{ar:أَحَطْنَا}} ({{tr:aḥaṭnā}}) take {{ar:مَا لَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:mā ladayhi}}) as its domain. It routes the verb toward a field rather than a bare direct object, and its attachment/contact pressure makes that field feel closely surrounded before {{ar:خُبْرًا}} ({{tr:khubran}}) names the knowledge-mode.

topics.headline: governed domain marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of encompassing is a governed domain, not a loose afterthought or the final knowledge noun.
topics.reason: Attachment and valency evidence show {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marking the complement selected by the encompassing verb.

topics.headline: contact pressure in fused domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fused {{ar:بِمَا}} ({{tr:bimā}}) makes the broad domain arrive as one compact governed unit.
topics.reason: The contact nuance is useful as particle pressure, but local syntax primarily licenses the bāʾ as a governed domain marker.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun that heads an open, governed domain completed by the following locative phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: locative possessor phrase completing the relative domain

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the encompassed content open while keeping it grammatically bounded. It is governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), heads the relative phrase, and waits for {{ar:لَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ladayhi}}) to complete it. The reader hears breadth first, then learns that the breadth belongs to Dhū al-Qarnayn's at-hand sphere.

topics.headline: open relative domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the domain is both syntactically controlled and semantically expansive.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as a relative pronoun, and attachment evidence confirms that it is governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and completed by {{ar:لَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ladayhi}}).

words.gloss_range: locative adverbial with attached masculine singular suffix, completing the relative domain as what is at hand with him

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: attached masculine singular suffix referring to Dhū al-Qarnayn
final accusative knowledge-mode after the relative domain

words.prose: {{ar:لَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ladayhi}}) fixes the open {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) to one possessor-domain. As a locative expression it makes the field what is at hand with him, and the attached masculine {{ar:ـهِ}} ({{tr:-hi}}) routes that field back to Dhū al-Qarnayn rather than to the sun or the exposed people of 18:90. It completes the relative phrase before {{ar:خُبْرًا}} ({{tr:khubran}}) states the mode of divine encompassing.

topics.headline: proximate possessor-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the broad domain is not vague; it is whatever lies within one protagonist's immediate sphere.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support {{ar:لَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ladayhi}}) as a locative expression with possessive suffix, completing the relative content of {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}).

topics.headline: suffix recovers Dhū al-Qarnayn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the attached suffix carries the protagonist across the ayah boundary without renaming him.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the masculine singular suffix to Dhū al-Qarnayn and warns against routing it to a nearer abstract or scene element.

topics.headline: relative completion before specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order: first the domain is located with him, then the final word names the knowledge-mode covering it.
topics.reason: The local syntax completes {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) with {{ar:لَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ladayhi}}) before the separate accusative specification.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative verbal noun specifying the encompassing as verified, comprehensive knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes report/information, tested inner knowledge, inquiry, soft low ground, cultivation/sharecropping, abundance in a waterskin or milk-rich camel, softness, and shared portions; local gerund selects knowledge by report/tested acquaintance, not the non-epistemic branches

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: encompassing verb specified by the final accusative
possessed relative domain distinct from the final accusative specification
adjectival divine-knowledge form contrasted with the local gerund
variant vocalization preserving the same accusative role

words.prose: {{ar:خُبْرًا}} ({{tr:khubran}}) is the final accusative specification, so it tells the reader what kind of encompassing {{ar:أَحَطْنَا}} ({{tr:aḥaṭnā}}) is. It is not another thing inside {{ar:مَا لَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:mā ladayhi}}), and it is not the adjective-title {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabīrun}}); it is a rare gerund that makes knowledge the clause's closing operation. The supported {{ar:خ ب ر}} ({{tr:kh-b-r}}) branch gives reportable, tested acquaintance, and the same-surah pairing with 18:68 reverses human non-encompassment into divine completed knowledge. Variant {{ar:خُبُرًا}} ({{tr:khuburan}}) expands the sound-weight while preserving the same accusative role.

topics.headline: accusative knowledge-mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word specifies the mode of encompassing, not a possessed item or loose object.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:خُبْرًا}} ({{tr:khubran}}) as an accusative tamyīz/specification of {{ar:أَحَطْنَا}} ({{tr:aḥaṭnā}}).

topics.headline: gerund process rather than title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on knowledge in operation rather than merely naming the knower with an attribute.
topics.reason: The local form is an indefinite gerund, while the broader root field includes the frequent adjective {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabīrun}}); the contrast is form-level, not a rejection of the divine-knowledge field.

topics.headline: tested and reportable knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the knowledge is not bare information; it has the pressure of probed, reliable acquaintance that can be stated in the divine aside.
topics.reason: V4 supports the report/tested-knowledge branch for {{ar:خ ب ر}} ({{tr:kh-b-r}}), while local syntax selects the knowledge result rather than a literal testing event or non-epistemic branch.

topics.headline: variant weight without syntactic shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recitational variant changes the closing word's internal weight without changing its grammatical job.
topics.reason: The variant {{ar:خُبُرًا}} ({{tr:khuburan}}) is useful for sound and form pressure, but the accusative specification role remains stable.

topics.headline: 18:68 reversal of human non-encompassment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare gerund answers an earlier same-surah inability frame with divine completed capacity (18:68).
topics.reason: The same-surah echo is concrete and contrastive: 18:68 denies human encompassing knowledge, while 18:91 places {{ar:خُبْرًا}} ({{tr:khubran}}) under divine completed encompassing.

topics.headline: dense closure and boundary cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word's compact sound and its boundary contrast with the prior closure at 18:90, while grammar remains the main interpretive control.
topics.reason: The acoustic and boundary observations are useful only after being limited by the syntactic fact that {{ar:خُبْرًا}} ({{tr:khubran}}) is a tamyīz.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of word 3 (ahata) with word 6 (khubran).
baseline_models.mechanism: All-sided enclosure combines with knowledge of an affair's interior, so the clause asserts exhaustive depth rather than receipt of a report.

activation_trace.role: Complete enclosure in knowledge supplies the mechanism's all-sided epistemic scope.
Knowledge of news and an affair's interior supplies depth beyond outward report.

changed_reading.before: God knew what was with him.
changed_reading.after: God's prior knowledge completely surrounds every side and inward reality of what was present to him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 3's preserving branch acts on the open referent 'what was with him,' while word 6 supplies informed inward awareness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Enclosure can be protective custody as well as perimeter; joined to khubr, it yields watchful care that knows what it preserves.

activation_trace.role: Preservation, care, and precaution turn encompassing into active custody.
Interior knowledge makes the proposed custody informed rather than merely defensive.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports detached awareness of his circumstances.
changed_reading.after: The clause can also place him and what attended him under informed, preserving oversight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The physical branches available at focus words 3 and 6 permit a terrain-level model without leaving the clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sensory enclosure combines with kh-b-r's low, soft, watered ground to picture knowledge as an all-around survey of the material station.

activation_trace.role: Physical surrounding or fencing supplies a surveyed perimeter.
Soft or low ground with water supplies the exploratory terrain content inside that perimeter.

changed_reading.before: Khubr is treated as purely propositional knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the knowledge is embodied as a complete survey of the ground and conditions at his station.

activation_trace.role: Complete epistemic enclosure gives the ordered account a scope larger than any one disclosed station.
Knowledge of the inner affair makes the sequence an informed account, not a bare travel list.
Following and succession make the promised recital an ordered trace.
Preserved recollection supplies continuity across the narrated stations.
The rope or connecting-link image joins otherwise separate stages into one itinerary.
Tracing mark after mark makes movement evidence-bearing and sequential.
The repeated trace-following renews the same ordered mechanism after the first station.
Trace-following immediately after the focus marks its clause as a checkpoint rather than an ending.
Arrival at a limit supplies the next bounded station in the traced sequence.

structural_cues: The route formula recurs at 18:85, 18:89, and immediately after the focus at 18:92.
The focus begins with a sealing 'thus' but the linked itinerary continues.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered recital, links, repeated following, and bounded arrivals; I infer that the focus clause calibrates the account's epistemic completeness at a midpoint. A live alternative is that it merely closes the eastern episode.

changed_reading.before: The clause is a free-standing assertion of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The clause is also a checkpoint saying that the already-complete account surrounds each locally disclosed stage while the traveler proceeds link by link.

context_deltas.mechanism: The total grant of power and connected means is followed by intended action and recompense; this broadens 'what was with him' from inventory to endowed capacities and their use.

activation_trace.role: Complete enclosure gathers capacities, choices, and consequences into one known field.
Knowledge of the inward affair reaches intention and use, not only visible possession.
Empowerment supplies operative capacity among the things present to him.
Giving marks those capacities as an endowment rather than self-originating property.
Totality and enclosure expand the endowment across the available field.
The knowable, reportable thing makes the broad grant available for epistemic accounting.
A connecting rope or means turns possession into usable access.
Intended action supplies the morally legible use of endowed capacity.
Recompense links the use of capacity to an answering consequence.

structural_cues: 18:84 grants power and every means before the ruler chooses between punishment and good at 18:86-88.
The focus's open phrase 'what was with him' follows another deployment of a route or means.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies granted power, total means, intended work, and recompense; I infer an accountability relation between endowment and use. The live narrower alternative is that the focus referent denotes only his immediate circumstances or retinue.

changed_reading.before: 'What was with him' means belongings, retinue, or current circumstances.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler koruyup gözetmeyi bildirir; önlem alma, engellenme ve şefkat gösterme okumaları yalnız tanıklanan biçim ve söz öbeklerinde geçerlidir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey korunur, gözetilir ve durumuyla sürekli ilgilenilir.

Belirli bir edilgen yapıda, kişilerin ilerlemesinin engellenmesi anlatılır.
Belirli bir söz öbeğinde, bir kimsenin başkasına karşı şefkat ve yakınlık duyması anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca yumuşak araziyi ve onun suyunu anlatmaz. Gevşek ya da alçak arazi, sıcak ve ağaçlı-sulu yer ile akışın oluşturduğu su birikintisi ayrı gerçekleşmelerdir; dal korunabilir, fakat su birikintisi arazi niteliğinin içine eritilmemelidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun ortaklaşa satın aldığı, kestiği ve etini aralarında paylaştığı koyunu belirtir. Bununla bağlantılı olarak, bölüşümde bir kişinin etten veya balıktan aldığı payı da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğun ortaklaşa satın alıp kestiği ve etini kendi arasında bölüştüğü koyunu belirtir.
Bir bölüşüm sonucunda kişiye düşen et veya balık payını belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik tanıklık ortaklaşa koyun satın alma, kesme ve eti bölüşme sürecini verir; etten veya balıktan alınan pay da bu bölüşüm çekirdeğinin sonuçsal uzantısıdır.

concept_gloss.text: ortak alınıp kesilen koyun veya bölüşülen et-balık payı
concept_gloss.applicability: Ortak alım, kesim ve bölüşüme konu olan koyunla bundan doğan yiyecek payının birlikte gösterildiği dal düzeyi açıklamada uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ortaklaşa alınan koyunu, kesim ve bölüşüm aşamalarını ve sonuçtaki et veya balık payını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun koyunu birlikte satın alıp kesmesi ve etini kendi arasında paylaşması bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ortak alım, kesim ve etin katılımcılar arasında bölüşülmesi sürecini korur.
error_profile.loses: Etten veya balıktan alınan genel pay uzantısını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir bölüşüm sonunda kişiye düşen et ya da balık bölümünün adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bölüşüm sonucunda alınan yiyecek payını korur.
error_profile.loses: Koyunun ortaklaşa satın alınması, kesilmesi ve bütün etinin paylaşılması olayını kapsamaz.

et veya balıktan alınan pay

error_profile.preserves: Bir bölüşümde kişiye düşen pay yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Mülkiyet, şirket ortaklığı veya soyut hak payı gibi çok daha geniş kullanım alanları ekler.
error_profile.collision: Ortak kesim olayını ve payın et ya da balık olması koşulunu belirsizleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ortak alınan koyun, kesim ve payın özellikle etten veya balıktan alınması koşulları bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeyden bir kişiye ayrılmış belirli hakkı veya bölümü genel olarak belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bölüşülen bir şeyden belirli bir kişiye düşen bölümü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yiyecek payını ortak koyun kesimiyle bağlantılı olarak sınırlar; komşu dal nesne türünden ve kesim sürecinden bağımsız genel pay kavramıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ortak satın alınan koyunun tamamını ve et ya da balık payını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bölüşümde ilk ayrılan payı ve özellikle büyük bir deve eti parçasını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kesilmiş hayvan etinin bölüşümünde bir kişiye ayrılan payı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda payın ilk olması veya büyük bir parça olması gerekmez ve balığı da kapsar; komşu dal ilk ayrılma ve deve eti özellikleriyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ortak koyun kesimi ile et veya balık olarak alınan payı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeyin tam üçte birini veya üçte ikisini oran olarak belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir bütünün bölünmesi ve bir bölümün ayrılması alanında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yiyecek türü ve ortak kesim süreciyle, komşu dal ise payın kesin oranıyla tanımlanır; biri diğerinin yerine geçmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel belirlenmiş pay, kesimde ilk ayrılan et payı ve oranlı bölümle kurulan üç sınır yayımlandı, yalnızca et türü veya miras bölüşümüyle ilgili daha uzak adaylar elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخُبْرة للشاة المشتركة التي يذبحها القوم ويقتسمون لحمها أو للنصيب من اللحم والسمك
branches.source_phrase_ar: الخُبْرة الشاة يشتريها القوم يذبحونها ويقتسمون لحمها (maqayis)؛ تخبر القوم بينهم خبرة إذا اشتروا شاة فذبحوها واقتسموا لحمها (jamhara)؛ الخبرة النصيب تأخذه من سمك أو لحم (sihah)

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, bilgi edinme ve iletmeden gevşek-sulu araziye, ürün paylı tarımsal ortakçılığa, büyük su tulumu ile bol verimli deve benzetmesine, birbiriyle yapısal olarak ayrılması gereken bitki-yün-köpük adlarına ve ortak kesim payına uzanan altı belirgin dal taşır. Dallar tek bir eş zamanlı çekirdekten çok bağımsız anlamlar ve sınırlı benzetme ya da sonuç ilişkileri halinde düzenlenir.

concept_gloss.text: bilgi edinme, bildirme ve deneyimle içyüzü kavrama

error.reason: Bu gloss haber ve aktarılan bilgiyi verir, sorarak veya deneyerek öğrenme ile iç nitelik anlamlarını kapsamaz.
Bu gloss bildirme eylemini verir, sınayıp tanıma ve içyüz bilgisi alanını dışarıda bırakır.
Bu gloss soru yoluyla bilgi aramayı verir, bilginin kendisini, bildirmeyi ve iç niteliği kapsamaz.
Bu gloss deneyim ve içyüz bilgisini verir, genel bilgi ve başkasına bildirme yönlerini ayrıca taşımaz.
Bu gloss deneyimli bilen kişiye odaklanır, bilgi nesnesi ve bildirme eylemi anlamlarını vermez.
Bu gloss içyüzü bilen kişiyi verir, bilgi aktarma ve soruşturup sınama süreçlerini kapsamaz.

lu_007.text: kişinin dış görünüşe karşı iç niteliği

error.reason: Bu gloss iç nitelik anlamını verir, bilgi edinme, bildirme ve deneyerek öğrenme alanlarını içermez.

concept_gloss.text: su tutan gevşek veya alçak arazi

error.collision: Su birikintisi anlamı arazi adının altında kalabilir.
error.reason: Ana etiket arazi niteliğini verir, akışın oluşturduğu geçilebilir su birikintisini ayrıca belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.text: yumuşak, alçak ve su toplayan toprak

error.reason: Bu gloss arazi niteliğini verir, akış yatağındaki geçilebilir su birikintisini ayrıca adlandırmaz.

lu_009.text: ılık, ağaçlı ve suyu bol yer

error.reason: Bu gloss sulu ve ağaçlı yer niteliğine odaklanır, gevşek alçak araziyi ve su birikintisini kapsamaz.
Bu gloss su birikintisini verir, gevşek arazi ve sıcak ağaçlı yer anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

concept_gloss.text: büyük su tulumu ve ona benzetilen bol sütlü dişi deve

contextual_glosses.text: su tulumu gibi bol sütlü dişi deve

error.reason: Bu gloss su tulumunu verir, ona benzetilen bol sütlü dişi deve anlamını kapsamaz.

lu_014.text: bol sütüyle büyük su tulumuna benzetilen dişi deve

error.reason: Bu gloss benzetmeli deve adını verir, kap olarak büyük su tulumunu adlandırmaz.

concept_gloss.text: ortak kesilen koyun ve et veya balık payı

contextual_glosses.text: bölüşümden düşen et veya balık payı

lu_018.text: ortaklaşa alınıp kesilen ve eti bölüşülen koyun

error.reason: Bu gloss ortak kesilen koyunu verir, bölüşümden düşen et veya balık payını kapsamaz.
Bu gloss pay anlamını verir, ortaklaşa alınıp kesilen koyunu adlandırmaz.
